extracted.intended_audience: nurses, doctors, and healthcare workers (potential contributors to McSweeney’s 'Flattened By the Curve')
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for healthcare workers to submit nonfiction, non-comedic first-person accounts about their experiences during the pandemic-era 'bewildering time' to McSweeney’s Flattened By the Curve feature. Includes content, length, metadata, contact, and an option for oral-history assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target contributors / authorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Nurses, doctors, and healthcare workers: McSweeney’s would love to hear from you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No matter where you are, if you feel like writing about your experiences at this bewildering time, we will be proud to publish your words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content type: nonfiction and non-comedic
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions should be nonfiction and non-comedic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should be nonfiction and non-comedic, and ideally 500 words or less, but any length is fine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject focus: firsthand experiences and feelings
rubrics_metrics.description: Tell us what the world needs to know about what you’re seeing and feeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize what you are seeing and feeling in your role as a healthcare worker during this bewildering time; the piece should convey what the world needs to know.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral-history / writer-assisted option
rubrics_metrics.description: If you'd like to tell your nonfiction story, oral-history style, to one of our writers and have them help shape it, please send a short summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send a short summary and McSweeney’s will try to find a writer/editor to support you in shaping the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required submission metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: With your submission, please include: Your name; Your role in medical field; Hospital or institution; City and State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide identifying information with the submission. Those who need anonymity will be accommodated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission contact / method
rubrics_metrics.description: Please email submissions to the provided address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email submissions (including the piece and required metadata or short summary for oral-history assistance) to: [email protected]

rubrics_metrics.name: AI policy / provenance attestation
rubrics_metrics.description: McSweeney’s accepts no writing aided in any manner by AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before publishing any writing—from a letter to a book-length work—authors published at McSweeney’s will be asked to attest that AI played no part in the creation or writing of that work.
